name: Talus Fracture
definition: Fracture of the talus, often caused by high-energy trauma and associated with risk of osteonecrosis, post-traumatic arthritis and soft-tissue compromise.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are initial; CT defines fracture morphology and displacement.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Displaced fractures commonly require fixation and long-term monitoring for AVN.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha/Asthi-bhagna framework may be documented after modern stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the talus, often caused by high-energy trauma and associated with risk of osteonecrosis, post-traumatic arthritis and soft-tissue compromise.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
